robot: Aegis quadruped with 12 leg joint targets and MuJoCo free base pose

closed_loop_behaviors.obstacle_avoidance: range-triggered detour target plus hard-obstacle safety projection
closed_loop_behaviors.inspection: package proximity lock with timed scan and anomaly-score export
closed_loop_behaviors.return_to_base: dispatch waypoint tracking with final-distance threshold
closed_loop_behaviors.evidence_export: trajectory, sensor manifest, stress replay, narration, storyboard, and report

limitations: The gait is a deterministic visualization controller, not a learned torque policy.
Stress replay perturbs logged trajectory evidence; it is not a full randomized re-render.
The task prioritizes legged autonomy and safety over multi-finger dexterity.
